# DEP-18 ruleset gating (shared cl-deposits / deposits-rust), generated by cl-deposits
# (inspect/rotation-test.lisp with CL_DEPOSITS_WRITE_VECTORS).  ruleset NAME family F rules R,..: the
# registry.  born_expired RULESET EXPIRY HEIGHT VIOLATION and collateral_floor RULESET RESERVES
# COLLATERAL FLOOR_BPS VIOLATION: a QuorumBegin judged under the ruleset it names (- for none).
# header cases: a LedgerOpen naming RULESET (- for none), the fault, and whether a
# NonConformingUpdate proof of it verifies.  The vault-spend twins are in vault_spend_anchor.txt.
